{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"Ops script: read-only verification of the SMS resend. Sends nothing.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/verify_resend.py
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import OUTBOX, delivery_status, sent_messages  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    status = delivery_status()
    msgs = sent_messages()
    original = msgs[:21]
    resent = msgs[21:]
    failed_ids = {m.id for m in original if status.get(m.id) == "failed"}
    by_id = {m.id: m for m in original}

    assert len(resent) == 10, f"expected 10 new lines, got {len(resent)}"
    assert [m.id for m in resent] == [f"SMS-{n:05d}" for n in range(22, 32)], "ids not sequential"
    assert {m.household_id for m in resent} == {
        "HH-10219", "HH-10855", "HH-10928", "HH-11142", "HH-12939",
        "HH-13498", "HH-14303", "HH-15695", "HH-16219", "HH-16438"}
    for m in resent:
        orig = by_id[m.household_id and next(i for i in failed_ids
                                             if by_id[i].household_id == m.household_id)]
        assert (m.household_id, m.phone, m.template_id, m.params, m.text) == \
               (orig.household_id, orig.phone, orig.template_id, orig.params, orig.text), \
               f"{m.id} does not copy its original"
    delivered = {m.household_id for m in original if status.get(m.id) == "delivered"}
    assert not delivered & {m.household_id for m in resent}, "a delivered household was texted"
    print("verification passed: 10 resends, sequential ids SMS-00022..SMS-00031,"
          " details copied, no delivered household texted")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
